profile_text.body:
Ambarella describes itself as a maker of AI vision processors for edge applications. The company says its imaging solutions make cameras smarter by extracting data from high-resolution video streams, and it names advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders, and autonomous vehicles among the uses it addresses.

The company is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, and trades under the ticker AMBA. Its SEC central index key is 0001280263. No specific products are tracked for it, and no MCP servers are recorded.

Its recorded litigation exposure is in California, where 281 matters are counted. No individual cases are listed.
